About.title: Flying you <hl>closer</hl> to what matters
About.subtitle: We're a modern airline built around one idea: travel should feel effortless, transparent, and human — in every language you speak.
About.storyTitle: Built around the people who fly
About.storyP1: DotAir began with a simple belief — that booking and managing a trip should be as pleasant as the journey itself. No hidden fees, no dead ends, no jargon.
About.storyP2: Today we connect cities across the world with a young, efficient fleet and a direct channel designed to put you in control, from search to check-in.

safety.title: Safety first
safety.desc: Every decision starts with the safety of our guests and crew — no compromises, ever.

guests.title: Guest-obsessed
guests.desc: We design around real travellers, with clear pricing and help whenever you need it.

planet.title: Lighter on the planet
planet.desc: A fuel-efficient fleet and smarter operations to shrink our footprint each year.

Baggage.title: Everything about your baggage
Baggage.subtitle: Cabin and checked allowances, extra bags, special items and what to do if something goes wrong.

cabin.title: Cabin baggage
cabin.intro: Every traveller may bring one personal item plus a carry-on bag, within the limits for their cabin.
cabin.personalItemNote: Fits under the seat in front — 40 × 30 × 15 cm.

checked.title: Checked baggage
checked.intro: Your free checked allowance depends on your cabin and fare. Weight limits are per piece.
checked.note: Light fares may not include checked baggage — add it during booking or in Manage.

extra.title: Extra & excess baggage
extra.body: Need more space? Add extra bags in advance to save versus airport rates.

a.title: Add before you fly
a.desc: Prepay extra bags in Manage booking up to 6 hours before departure.

b.title: Overweight & oversized
b.desc: Bags above your weight limit are carried for an additional fee where space allows.

special.title: Special baggage
special.body: Travelling with something out of the ordinary? Let us know in advance so we can prepare.

sports.title: Sports equipment
sports.desc: Skis, golf clubs and bikes travel as checked baggage in a suitable case.

music.title: Musical instruments
music.desc: Small instruments fit in the cabin; larger ones can use an extra seat.

medical.title: Medical & mobility
medical.desc: Wheelchairs and essential medical devices are carried free of charge.

infant.title: Strollers & car seats
infant.desc: One stroller and one car seat per child, carried free of charge.

restricted.title: Restricted & prohibited items
restricted.body: For everyone’s safety, some items are limited or not allowed on board.
restricted.cabinOnlyItems: Power banks, spare lithium batteries, e-cigarettes.
restricted.checkedOnlyItems: Sharp objects, tools and sporting bats.
restricted.prohibitedItems: Explosives, flammable liquids and gases, and other dangerous goods.
restricted.note: If in doubt, check with our team before you travel.

help.title: Delayed or damaged baggage
help.body: If your bag does not arrive with you or is damaged, report it at the airport baggage desk before you leave, then track its status online.
